char_objects_rule.multiplayer_animate: reset_hair, then play ui_loop | kPlayLast kPlayGraphLoop
char_objects_rule.single_player_animate: reset_hair, then play ui_enter kPlayNoBlend, then play ui_loop | kPlayLast kPlayGraphLoop

proof_capture.reference_base: live toe-row floor when toe bones exist

proof_event_rationale: The stock 2P character-select screen displays characters through {char_multi char_event $playerNum animate}; the select event is only the outfit focus/load path. Proof captures therefore use animate and must log reset_hair=true.
isolated_ui_clip_caveat: char/*/anims/gen/*_ui.milo_ps2:ui_loop is the clip used by both 2P animate and 2P select events, but isolated viewer captures are not complete 2P select proof unless paired with char_multi script, the animate event, char_objects event evidence, and placer evidence.
